facts.fact: India Post's savings page gives the Senior Citizens Savings Scheme rate as 8.2% per annum
facts.quote: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme Account (SCSS) Rate of Interest: 8.2% per annum
facts.note: The India Post page shows 'Last Updated On: 19.10.2026' (within Q3 FY 2026-27).

facts.fact: Rates for 1 Oct - 31 Dec 2026 (Q3 FY 2026-27) were set by DEA's Office Memorandum dated 30.09.2026
facts.quote: Revision of interest rates for Small Savings Schemes for Q3 2026-27 30.09.2026

facts.fact: The NSI rate table's latest row shows SCSS at 8.2% from 1.04.2023 to 30.09.2026 (up to Q2 FY 2026-27)
DEA's OM of 30.09.2026 keeps all small savings rates for Oct-Dec 2026 (Q3 FY 2026-27) unchanged from Q2, so SCSS stays at 8.2%
facts.note: Quoted from the OCR of the scanned OM. The 8.2% is derived: the OM keeps Q2 rates, and NSI shows SCSS at 8.20 to 30.09.2026.
facts.quote: The rates of interest on various Small Savings Schemes for the third quarter of FY 2026-27 starting from 1% October, 2026 and ending on 31° December, 2026 shall remain unchanged from those notified for the second quarter

summary: SCSS 8.2% confirmed (India Post current page updated 19.10.2026; NSI to 30.09.2026); DEA Q3 2026-27 OM dated 30.09.2026 confirmed; 'unchanged from Q2' only in the scanned OM (manual).
